ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Cells and Batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cells and Batteries.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cells and Batteries.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cells and Batteries.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Cells and Batteries.

2. When learning Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.

3. When learning Pictorial Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pictorial Drawings.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings.

4. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

5. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

7. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance.

8. When learning Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2., the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   D. Skip safety briefings for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

10. When learning D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

12. When learning Introduction to Electricity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Electricity.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Electricity.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Electricity.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Electricity.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Magnetism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Electro- Magnetism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.

3. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings.

4. C — Information and Communication Technology

5. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.

6. C — CPU

7. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance.

8. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..

9. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

10. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Electricity.
